snippet.title: MorTown - New Hotbar and Weapons!! - Minigun - NSV - FN MINIMI
snippet.description:
Weapons & Combat
- Hotbar added, can equip 2 weapons (ranged and mele) and 2 usables.
- Reworked weapon and bullet system.
- Bullets no longer pass through walls (except for drone bullets or special bullets).
- New visual effects for ranged weapons.
- 3 new ranged weapons added:
--- FN Minimi (Light Machine Gun)
--- NSV (Heavy Machine Gun)
--- Minigun (go brrtrrtrtrrtrtrt)

Timeline:
00:00 Hotbar
00:54 FN MINIMI
01:30 NSV
02:07 MINIGUN
02:45 Usables (food and medic items)
04:20 That's it :)

Also join our discord server if you would like to share some ideas!!
https://discord.gg/HfupRmgJCr
and stay tuned for future updates :)

(the lag in the video is due to obs, sorry about that)
